prerequisites.title: Public home page and privacy policy
prerequisites.detail: The home page must be publicly accessible and the privacy policy hosted on the same domain and linked on the consent screen.

prerequisites.title: Verified domain ownership
prerequisites.detail: Verify the top private domain in Google Search Console with an Owner or Editor account on the project.

prerequisites.title: Policy compliance
prerequisites.detail: The app must comply with the Google API Services User Data Policy, and data use must match the published privacy policy.

steps.title: Choose narrowest Gmail scopes
steps.detail: List the scopes the agent needs and replace restricted ones with sensitive or non-sensitive ones where possible. Draft per-scope justification for why narrower scopes are not enough.
steps.done_when: Final scope list and justifications are written

steps.title: Create Cloud project and consent screen
steps.detail: Configure Branding, Audience and Data Access in the Google Auth platform and declare all scopes. Create a Web application OAuth client.
steps.done_when: Consent screen and OAuth client exist

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the Gmail auth config via Composio's API with your client ID and secret. Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard into the Google OAuth client.

steps.title: Verify domain in Search Console
steps.detail: Prove ownership of the domains used on the consent screen and in redirect URIs.

steps.title: Verify and publish branding
steps.detail: Click Verify Branding, then Publish branding once status is Ready to publish. Publish within 7 days.

steps.title: Prepare demo video and justifications
steps.detail: Draft a script showing the English OAuth grant flow, the app name, the client ID in the address bar, and each scope's feature.
steps.done_when: Script and justifications are ready to record

steps.title: Record video and submit verification
steps.detail: Record the demo and click Submit for verification in the Verification Center. Watch email for follow-ups from Trust & Safety.

steps.title: Wait for Google verification
steps.detail: Sensitive scope verification typically takes 3-5 business days; follow-up questions can extend it.

traps.title: Apps in Testing status have a 7-day refresh token
traps.detail: Apps in Testing status have a 7-day refresh token expiration limit, and a Google Workspace admin marking the app as Trusted overrides this limit along with the 100-test-user cap.

traps.title: Apps in testing status are still subject to a
traps.detail: Apps in testing status are still subject to a tester warning screen, a user cap, and a limited refresh token lifetime.

traps.title: Unverified apps hit a 100-user cap
traps.detail: An unverified app requesting sensitive or restricted scopes shows warnings and is capped at 100 total users.

traps.title: Testing status breaks tokens after 7 days
traps.detail: Testing apps have a 7-day refresh token limit and a 100 test user cap, so do not launch to customers in Testing.

traps.title: Brand verification expires in 7 days
traps.detail: A compliant result is valid 7 days; if not published in that time you must run it again.

traps.title: Branding is locked during verification
traps.detail: You cannot change branding while verification is in progress without cancelling it.

traps.title: Composio's callback domain can't be verified by you
traps.detail: Google requires authorized domains for redirect URIs to be verified. You cannot verify Composio's domain, so route the callback through your own domain with a proxy that returns a 302 redirect, not a server-side fetch.

traps.title: Managed app shows Composio's name
traps.detail: With Composio's managed app users see 'Composio wants to access your account' and default scopes apply.

blockers.symptom: 'This app isn't verified' warning on consent screen
blockers.what_it_means: The app requests sensitive scopes and has not completed verification.
blockers.what_to_do: Submit for verification; developers can click through Advanced during development.
blockers.agent_can_help: Prepare scope justifications and the demo script.

blockers.symptom: Verification video or info requests by email from Trust & Safety
blockers.what_it_means: Google needs more information before deciding.
blockers.what_to_do: Reply with the requested steps or information.
